headline: Taiwan CPC Keeps Domestic Gasoline and Diesel Prices Steady
summary: State-owned CPC Corporation in Taiwan announced it will keep domestic gasoline and diesel prices unchanged next week despite rising international crude costs.
why: State control over retail fuel pricing in Asian markets is often used as a direct policy tool to insulate consumers and curb broader inflationary pressures.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Absorbing rising international oil costs protects consumer fuel prices but puts pressure on state-owned refining margins.
